notes.title: ver2.0 New Mode "Mini-Game" Released!!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing C.A.R.D.S. RPG: The Misty Battlefield. 
We are excited to announce our latest update!

[h2][b]What's the New Mode "Mini-Game"?[/b][/h2]

Players select a single unit and navigate a grid-based map, engaging in battles, upgrading, and making critical decisions. Your route and deck-building choices within limited turns will determine your success against the boss!

You can select "Mini-Game" from the title screen, and it's accessible even to new players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/e7afb7ba68da3f02978323a9e36542679ff19076.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Highlights of the New Mode[/b][/h2]

1. Quick, Yet Deep Gameplay!
Each game session takes about 20 minutes. Fight enemies, level up your unit, and collect powerful cards to build a unique deck. Enjoy strategic growth and deck-building even in short play sessions!

2. Freely Explore Tactical Maps
Move freely around the map in any direction. Will you avoid enemies to gather equipment or confront them head-on to level up? Each decision you make significantly impacts your survival and success within limited turns.

3. Growth Cycle: Stronger with Every Attempt
Even if defeated, you retain one card and one equipment item for your next attempt, allowing continuous improvement. Gradually develop your unit and construct the ultimate deck for your next challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/1870b78003d2a96f350adb727b7733a892bc9112.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/6e2f0362bf1f90bb83382ce3a540528734f2a08c.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]How to Play the New Mode[/b][/h2]

1. Select Your Unit
Each character has unique initial decks and abilities. Choose the one that best suits your strategic style.

2. Explore the Map
Move around the map turn by turn, engage in battles, events, and card collection to prepare for the boss encounter.

3. Prepare for the Boss Within Limited Turns
Choose when to engage the boss—early or after maximum preparation. It's entirely up to your strategy.

4. Defeat the Boss and Advance
Victory unlocks the next difficulty level. Even in defeat, you carry forward one card and one equipment, letting you try again with an improved setup!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/573d31b628cd2a856faa6589e58306a7af29b781.jpg[/img]


Your new adventure starts now!
We can't wait to hear your feedback on the new mode—give it a try and let us know what you think!



Please note: The DEMO version will not receive this update.


If you have any questions or requests, please post them on Discord or Steam Community.

Discord: https://discord.gg/ajawXaQqnK

Steam Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2539880/discussions/


Thank you for your continued support of "C.A.R.D.S. RPG: The Misty Battlefield".

notes.title: [ver1.3.0] Challenge Stages, New Cards, and More!
notes.content:
We’re excited to share the latest updates with you!

1) Challenge Stages Added
We’ve added six new challenge stages with unique victory conditions that set them apart from regular stages!  
Challenge stages will unlock as you clear specific regular stages.  

Here are the objectives you can look forward to:
- Eliminate all enemies within XX phases
- Defeat the boss without losing any allies
- Survive for XX phases
- Retrieve the stolen equipment

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/45c657b93cbe256f5f6802a1ad2c841352eeab54.png[/img]


2) New Cards Available  
Eight new cards have been added, designed to be easier to obtain in challenge stages. 
Most of them have effects that increase with upgrades, so be sure to take on the challenge stages!

Here’s a look at the new cards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/2c283debfdb0df08048e6c6d081737e0f1202065.png[/img]


3) Commander Skill Screen: New Unit Details UI for Unit Unlocks
Now, when you hover over the unit unlock icon and press the Unit Details button, you can view detailed information about the unit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/bde093014d20007156ad98a64bbe35807e70af91.png[/img]


4) Minor Bug Fixes


Please note: The DEMO version will not receive this update.

notes.title: [ver1.2] New Features, Some Specification Changes, and Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
We have made the following updates and would like to inform you:

▼ New Features
1. Stage Selection Screen Introduced in Story Mode  
   A stage selection screen has been introduced in Story Mode, making it easier to track overall progress. You can now freely choose stages, allowing you to play cleared stages if you get stuck, making it easier to clear difficult stages. Other functions remain the same as in World Map Mode, and in the stage selection screen, you can "change unit equipment", "check your deck", and view "a list of cards obtainable in each stage."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/7d62bce362fae26a5a7ac9b4b9e7ddec1523408e.png[/img]

2. Individual Unit Deck Building: Discard Screen Post-Stage Clear  
   We have visualized how many cards each unit selects on the discard screen after clearing a stage. In the discard screen where 0 to 5 cards can be discarded, we have adjusted the UI so you can immediately see how many cards each unit is discarding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/832c2a85994ade2aeb4735b8260537069c1ab5f0.png[/img]

3. Easier Stage Retries During Gameplay  
   You can now easily retry a stage during gameplay! By opening the pause menu, you can restart the stage. This feature is useful if you didn’t get the cards you wanted or accidentally let a unit die and want to start over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716190/93288ee2b557dffba7b45e2840b5280f83ad7767.png[/img]


▼ Some Specification Changes
1. Buff/Debuff System Adjustments  
   Buffs and debuffs applied during combat can now carry over to the next battle. Previously, they were reset after each battle, but with this change, strategies like lowering the enemy’s defense to increase damage from other units are now possible.

2. Equipment Gained During Stages Can Be Equipped Post-Stage  
   Equipment acquired during a stage can now be equipped during the preparation phase after clearing the stage. Previously, only the unit that gained the equipment could change it during the stage. Based on feedback that this was unclear, we simplified this mechanic to make it more user-friendly.

3. Unit Placement Pre-Stage Changed to Full Unit Deployment (Up to 8 Units)  
   Previously, the number of units deployable was limited per stage, but this restriction has been removed. Now, you can use all your units to tackle each stage!

4. Removed Full HP Recovery When Voltage Increases  
   Previously, HP was fully restored when Voltage increased, but we felt that managing HP while challenging bosses is a key aspect of roguelike deck-building games (and SRPGs as well). To enhance this sense of tension, we made this adjustment. After clearing a stage, all units will fully recover their HP.

▼ Balance Adjustments
1. Adjusted the Difficulty of Enemies Across All Stages  
   The difficulty of enemies in all stages has been adjusted. The difficulty of the latter stages has been increased compared to the previous version. If you get stuck on a stage, try replaying cleared stages to acquire cards and strengthen your deck! Additionally, by using Commander Skills to boost all units' stats, progressing through stages should become easier.

2. Adjusted the Following Cards:
   [Knight's Resolve]  
   Adjustment: Effect  
   Before: Cavalry only, +15 damage, 60% defense increase (3 turns) 
   New: Cavalry only. Attack: +10 Additional Damage Increase Defense by 60% (1 turns)
   *Note: Strengthening this card increases the added damage and the number of turns for the defense boost.

   [Divine Protection]  
   Adjustment: Effect  
   Before: Removes all debuffs  
   New: Dispels all debuffs. Heals 1 HP with 1 hand card.
   *Note: Strengthening this card increases the amount of HP restored.

   [Enchanted Shield]  
   Adjustment: Cost  
   Before: Cost 1  
   New: Cost 2

*Please note that there are no updates for the DEMO version.

notes.title: You can now create individual decks for each unit.
notes.content:
We are pleased to inform you of the following update.

With this update, you can now choose between two deck-building styles: "Shared Deck / Individual Deck."

[h3]What is Individual Deck Building?[/h3]
- Each unit has its own deck and progresses through the stages.
- In battles, units can use the cards they possess to fight.
- Additionally, the deck can give units their own unique characteristics.
- This is recommended for those who want to enjoy a deeper strategic element in deck building!

* You can change your cards from the card list before starting a stage.

Here are some convenient features for creating individual decks for units!

[h3]Card Transfer Function Between Units[/h3]
In the stage preparation screen, you can exchange cards between units.
Create unique characteristics for your units with the decks and take on the stages!

During stage play, you can pass one card at a time to adjacent units with each action.
Utilize this effectively to progress strategically in battles!

This feature is available only in "Individual Deck Building."
